titulo.estudio: Comparer deux offres : Repérer les informations

intro: Compare features, price and limits in two product descriptions. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Compare features, price and limits in two product descriptions. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: « Moins cher » compares price; « pourtant » can introduce an advantage that offsets a drawback. In this passage, «offre» means «offer».

frases.estudio: L'offre A propose un vélo électrique à 890 euros, avec une garantie de deux ans.
frases.alumno: Offer A provides an electric bicycle for 890 euros, with a two-year warranty.

frases.estudio: L'offre B coûte 760 euros, mais sa batterie a une autonomie plus courte.
frases.alumno: Offer B costs 760 euros, but its battery has a shorter range.
